But they ask to compute cost and provide estimated total payable amount. So we just compute cost. We might also need to get the user's balance? Not specified. Just compute cost.

Thus call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then respond with cost.
